EmailTemplate.subject: TOMORROW...[WEBINAR] Set to Soar: How Consumer Travel Plans Point to a Tourism Boom
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
When will travelers start booking? Where will they go? How much will they spend? We surveyed frequent leisure travelers to find out! Join our webinar "Set to Soar: How Consumer Travel Plans to a Tourism Boom <[[https://more.flywire.com/Webinar_TravelSurvey21.html?utm_source=email2]]>" and be the first to hear the survey results on Wednesday, May 12th at 12 PM ET. Take away best practices and steps your company can take to prepare for the return to travel. Tune in as a panel of travel industry experts discuss the key findings. Panelists: Dustin Figge, Homelike, CEO & Founder
Erling Aspelund, Iceland Encounter, Owner
Nicole Murray, Keefer Lake Lodge, Guest Relations Manager Register If you can't make the live webinar, please register, and we will share the recording after the broadcast.
